finding: Conflicting unqualified LMS bundle price
disposition: Active coupon verified through real read-only route: standard ₹3,300, discount ₹1,400, eligible total ₹1,900; separate conditional offer label. No coupon algorithm changed.

finding: Lifetime course promise conflicts with 365-day access
disposition: Removed generic lifetime promise and false 365-day default. All five real published records have access_days=NULL. Show product-specific duration only when persisted; requested 365-day correction including existing enrollments is reviewed but separately scoped.

finding: Homepage has no Workspace product introduction
disposition: Compact Workspace section follows featured LMS courses; secondary hero Become a Creator links to /workspace.

finding: Workspace navigation disappears at 1024px
disposition: Accessible menu at 1024 and all widths; Workspace always reachable; full desktop navigation at 1200+.

finding: Narrow header logo and theme hitboxes overlap
disposition: Readable brand, two mobile utilities and distinct 44px menu/theme targets; no control overlap at 320.

finding: Primary CTA and navigation contrast defects
disposition: Public scoped contrast tokens; no white-on-white closing sign-in; 34 solid-background normal-text samples >=4.5:1.

finding: Carousel exposes inactive links and keeps rotating during keyboard focus
disposition: Autoplay/carousel/slides removed. Static course-first hero; no hidden tab targets.

finding: Early Access capability hierarchy is outdated
disposition: Current profile/proposal/review/private text building leads; planned media/publication/sales and November readiness explicitly separate.

finding: Membership costs and paid-term start are undiscoverable pre-application
disposition: Server-read current plans render ₹5,899 / ₹9,999 / ₹17,699 incl. 18% GST; pre-launch paid term start 9 November 00:00 IST explained.

finding: Workspace policy names are not links and refund summary is absent
disposition: Direct Creator Terms/Refund Policy/support links; 72-hour window from verified payment time, not launch date.

finding: Crawler endpoints redirect to login HTML
disposition: Metadata routes return 200 text/plain and XML; middleware permits only exact crawler paths, private routes remain protected.

finding: Shared Workspace header steers visitors back to LMS purchases
disposition: Courses-first navigation, explicit LMS Pricing, selected Workspace context and Check Eligibility CTA; no fictitious routes.

finding: Public eligibility explanation omits concrete requirements
disposition: Read published policy version 9: 24 months, required HTTPS profile, current categories; adult declaration and separate course approval explained. No fallback threshold.

finding: Current private course-building workflow is unclear
disposition: Account/eligibility/applicable access path/profile/proposal/review/approved private text builder sequence, including paid email/legal steps and scoped complimentary grants.

finding: No Workspace FAQ or complimentary-path explanation
disposition: Nine factual Creator FAQs plus policy/support links; no unrestricted free-membership offer.

finding: Repeated sections inflate page length
disposition: Eight sections per page; duplicated trust/features consolidated. Desktop homepage 11,172 → 5,834px; 390px homepage 17,657 → 10,131px.

finding: Credibility claims need owner evidence
disposition: Unsubstantiated faculty/heritage/outcome text removed from refreshed page/shell copy. Neutral factual descriptions used. Existing artwork may contain legacy embedded promotional claims; owner proof or approved replacement remains required before release.

finding: Visual asset provenance is undocumented
disposition: Existing imagery/logo reused under approved design scope; no claim of licensing confirmation, no new bitmap assets. Artwork rights/provenance require owner confirmation.

finding: Resource and server/client boundaries merit measured optimization
disposition: One hero priority asset; responsive next/image dimensions/sizes and lazy card images; bounded six-row public query and small public DTO; no carousel preloads. Native image optimizer delivery is still unverified in this local harness.

finding: Source fallback conflates unavailable data with empty catalog
disposition: Distinct unavailable vs empty catalog; no fictional fallback amount/course; pending refresh retry and generic public loading skeleton.

finding: Canonical/social metadata is absent
disposition: Route-specific canonical/Open Graph/Twitter metadata; public sitemap. Origin based on existing invoice/certificate project links; live production configuration not inspected.

finding: Semantics and explicit search labeling need refinement
disposition: Global skip-to-main, explicit search label, coherent headings and accessible native details; modal focus trap/restoration and readable touch targets.

finding: AirBharath naming varies
disposition: AirBharath brand spelling consistent; legal names, original course titles and historical evidence preserved.

finding: Decoration and passive hover treatments compete with content
disposition: Restrained editorial composition, scoped color and static visuals; no decorative autoplay, fake interactive cards or new animation dependencies.
